summary: 取消工作流时 grace 超时后仍有异步任务残留执行

suggestedFix: 超时后遍历 running 中的 task 记录并调用每个 task 独立的 abort 回调，或在 scheduler 层维护 task-level AbortController

summary: onNodeReady 异常时 throwDurationMs 使用非空断言可能崩溃

summary: BFS uses Array.shift() which is O(n) per operation, making traversal O(n²) for large workflows
evidence: workflow-utils.ts:52 const cur = queue.shift()! — shift() on an array re-indexes all remaining elements, O(n) per call. For workflows with 100+ nodes, this produces O(n²) behavior instead of O(n). Also at :97 same pattern in computeFullExecutionSet. Impact is moderate — workflows with 1000+ nodes (unusual but possible) would experience measurable slow startup.
suggestedFix: Replace queue.shift() with index pointer (let i=0; while(i<queue.length) { const cur=queue[i++] }) or use a proper Queue

summary: Segmented view toggle uses Button border-radius override instead of shadcn ToggleGroup
evidence: runner-toolbar.tsx:36-55: two Buttons wrapped in a div with border rounded-md, first has className="rounded-r-none h-7", second has "rounded-l-none h-7". This manually creates a segmented control appearance by mutating Button border radius. Per design.md, shadcn components should be composed as-is. ToggleGroup from @/components/ui is the correct approach for segmented toggles.

summary: list() calls get() per workflow, reading ALL version files for each; N+1 read amplification
evidence: workflow-service.ts:48 const defs = await Promise.all(ids.map((id) => this.get(id))). get() at :68-73 reads all version files, sorts them, then tries to parse the newest. For M workflows with average V versions each, this does M×V file reads on every list() call. Only the newest file per workflow is needed for WorkflowMeta.
suggestedFix: Add a lightweight index file per workflow (e.g. meta.json) that list() reads instead of full definition. Avoid reading all version files.

summary: Side-effect implicit edges to End may cause End node to be out-of-order vs skipped detection in post-processing
evidence: workflow-utils.ts:109-115 — side-effect leaf nodes get implicitEdge to endNode. workflow-engine.ts:109-115 deduplicates edges. But at :336-346, post-processing checks if endNodeId not in nodeOutputs AND endResult.status===skipped. With implicit edges, End may have pending count > 0 (awaiting side-effect branches), but scheduler cleanup at :221-225 only skips non-residual ids. Race: if side-effect branches never start (e.g. upstream skip propagation), End stays pending and is NOT in results → marked by :221-225.
suggestedFix: After scheduler completes, check if End is in results before marking it as skipped. Add explicit fallback node status for implicit-edge End nodes.

summary: useEffect for queued message dispatch has missing dependency on pendingMessages
evidence: agent/index.tsx:180-190. useEffect depends on [chat.sendMessage, chat.sendingConversationIds, pendingMessages] — but at :185, setPendingMessages update uses functional updater (which is safe), BUT the closure captures pendingMessages for the firstQueuedMessageForIdleTarget check at :181. If pendingMessages is updated from another path, this effect may miss the update and queue stale messages. The effect at :103-118 also captures pendingSession without it in deps array.
suggestedFix: Use a ref for pendingMessages or restructure to useReducer to eliminate closure staleness

summary: Stale cleanup deletes concurrent .tmp files creating race condition
evidence: RunSnapshotService.save() lines 66-82: stale cleanup calls readdir() and deletes ALL .tmp files (line 71-74) in the workflow runs directory. If two saves (e.g. auto-save + manual save) occur concurrently for the same workflow, one save's cleanup phase deletes the other's in-progress .tmp file before rename(). The second save's rename() fails with ENOENT → saveRunSnapshot() catches and logs (ipc.ts:84-101) but the save fails silently.
suggestedFix: Only clean up .tmp files older than 60 seconds in stale cleanup, or use a unique temp prefix per save attempt

summary: taskFactory crash before onNodeReady misreported as skipped instead of failed
evidence: Scheduler tryStart() (workflow-scheduler.ts:112-125): catches taskFactory() throw, calls onNodeDone with status='failed'. But engine's onNodeDone (workflow-engine.ts:228-231) checks 'const nr = nodeResults[outcome.nodeId]; if (!nr) return' -- nodeResults entry was never created (onNodeReady at scheduler.ts:114 was not reached). Post-processing loop (workflow-engine.ts:296-303) creates 'skipped' entry, losing the actual failure. User sees node as skipped with no error info.
suggestedFix: In engine's onNodeDone, if nodeResults[outcome.nodeId] is undefined and outcome.status is 'failed', initialize the entry from outcome before updating

summary: Session resetting 期间新消息被直接 throw Error，没有排队或降级处理
evidence: 行71-73: if (this.resettingConversations.has(conversationId)) { throw new Error("Session is resetting.") }。重置是最多几秒的操作，但抛出 Error 会导致调用方(如 agent-runtime-service.ts 中 handleNewMessage) catch 后返回错误给用户。用户看到「Session is resetting」而非有意义的提示
suggestedFix: 重置期间将新消息入队等待，而非直接 throw；重置完成后自动发送排队消息

summary: handleConfigChange 直接修改 reactflow 节点配置后不等待确认就更新 definition state，导致配置面板和画布短暂不同步
evidence: 行140: canvasRef.current?.updateNodeConfig(nodeId, config) 直接调用 reactflow 内部方法。行141-168: setDefinition((def) => {...}) 异步更新 React state。在 setDefinition 的 render 完成前，NodeConfigPanel 读到的 definition 是旧值，而 canvas 已显示新配置——两者短暂不一致。极短时间内(同一 React 批处理)可忽略，但如果 config 变化触发了重校验或副作用，可能读到过期数据
suggestedFix: 将 canvasRef update 移到 setDefinition 回调内部，保证 state 更新后才操作 canvas

summary: 运行器 RunnerApp 的 handleRetry 只重试 loadError 但不会重新订阅 workflow events
evidence: 行245-249: handleRetry 重置 loadError 和 definition state 并递增 retrySignal，但 useEffect 订阅 workflow events (行115-149) 只依赖 [workflowId]，retrySignal 变化不会重新订阅。如果 event 订阅因某种原因断开(如 IPC 桥临时不可用)，重试无法恢复事件流
suggestedFix: 在 handleRetry 中主动重新订阅 events，或让 events useEffect 依赖 retrySignal

summary: Stale cleanup deletes concurrent .tmp files creating race condition
evidence: RunSnapshotService.save() stale cleanup (lines 66-82) calls readdir() and deletes ALL .tmp files (line 71-74) in the workflow runs directory. If two saves occur concurrently for the same workflow (e.g. auto-save + manual save), one save's cleanup phase deletes the other's in-progress .tmp file before rename(). The second save's rename() fails with ENOENT → saveRunSnapshot() catches and logs (ipc.ts:84-101) but the save fails silently. The write-to-tmp-then-rename atomic pattern prevents data corruption, but concurrent saves suffer spurious failures.
suggestedFix: Only clean up .tmp files older than 60 seconds in stale cleanup, or use a unique temp prefix per save attempt

summary: taskFactory crash before onNodeReady misreported as skipped instead of failed
evidence: Scheduler tryStart() (workflow-scheduler.ts:112-125): catches taskFactory() throw, calls onNodeDone with status='failed'. But engine's onNodeDone (workflow-engine.ts:228-231) does 'const nr = nodeResults[outcome.nodeId]; if (!nr) return' — nodeResults entry was never created because onNodeReady at scheduler.ts:114 (called after taskFactory) was not reached. The failure is silently dropped. Post-processing loop (workflow-engine.ts:296-303) creates a 'skipped' entry, losing the actual failure. User sees node as skipped with no explanation.
suggestedFix: In engine's onNodeDone, if nodeResults[outcome.nodeId] is undefined and outcome.status is 'failed', initialize the entry from outcome before updating

summary: Runner retry mechanism has no cooldown, enabling rapid re-fetch loop
evidence: handleRetry (runner-app.tsx:245-249) unconditionally clears state and increments retrySignal, triggering two useEffect re-runs (hydration + fallback definition). No minimum interval or debounce. Each click fires IPC calls (workflow.runStatus + possibly workflow.get) even though the cleanup flag (cancelled) discards all but the last result. Under network/backend degradation, rapid clicks amplify backend load unnecessarily. While correctness is preserved by the cancelled flag, each IPC call still consumes backend resources.
suggestedFix: Add a useRef-based cooldown (e.g., 1s minimum interval) in handleRetry, or use a loading state to disable the button during retry

summary: Unnecessary continue statements in param validation loop
evidence: In the param name validation loop (workflow-validator.ts:42-52), 'continue' on lines 45 and 49 skip the only remaining statement paramNamesSeen.add(trimmed) — which is correctly skipped for invalid params. But the 'continue' implies there is additional processing to skip, which is misleading. The same pattern in node ID (line 70) and edge ID (line 151) validation serves a real purpose (skipping remaining iterations of complex logic), but the param 'continue' is dead control flow.
suggestedFix: Remove the 'continue' statements in the param name validation block; the natural flow already achieves the correct behavior

suggestedFix.summary: Raw <button> with card-like styling instead of shadcn <Card> component
suggestedFix.evidence: empty-repository-state.tsx:390-424 renders two manual <button> elements with className 'rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4 hover:bg-accent...' simulating Card appearance. This duplicates shadcn's Card primitives — the component already provides the exact same surface visual. Violates design.md priority order which prefers shadcn components over custom primitives.
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: Replace raw <button> with <Card> composition: <Card as="button" className="..." onClick={...}><CardHeader><CardTitle>...</CardTitle></CardHeader></Card>

suggestedFix.summary: Header border uses sidebar-specific token instead of standard border-border
suggestedFix.evidence: app-shell-layout.tsx:19: <header className="... border-b border-sidebar-border/50 ..."> uses --sidebar-border token (defined at globals.css:83) which is intended for sidebar panel borders, not the app shell header. Per design.md $6: 'shell 不保留独立的品牌壳层样式...共享同一套视觉基线'. Using border-border would be consistent with the shared baseline. The /50 opacity modifier further deviates from standard token usage.
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: Replace 'border-sidebar-border/50' with 'border-border' (or 'border-border/50' if opacity is intentional)

suggestedFix.summary: useChatEvents 依赖 state.sessions 和 status.agentType 导致事件订阅频繁重建，期间事件丢失
suggestedFix.evidence: useChatEvents useEffect deps L236-251 含 state.sessions(每次 dispatch 新引用)和 state.status?.agentType → 每次消息更新触发 unsubscribe→subscribe → 窗口期事件丢失 → 消息不完整/状态不同步
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: 将 state.sessions 和 state.status?.agentType 通过 useRef 缓存，Effect 中读取 ref.current

suggestedFix.summary: 权限模式切换 Dialog 的确认按钮 void 异步操作，用户可重复点击导致竞态
suggestedFix.evidence: AgentComposer L252: void onPermissionModeChange(mode) → onPermissionModeChange 可能是 async(Promise<void>) → void 丢弃 rejection → 快速双击触发两次并行变更 → 最终模式不确定
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: onPermissionModeChange 改为 await 并在 pending 期间 disabled 确认按钮

suggestedFix.summary: pumpQueryEvents while 退出后 finally 前 send() 可通过 this.finished 检查推入 input 队列，消息永久滞留
suggestedFix.evidence: send() L100-120: 先检查 this.closed → false, 再检查 this.finished → 尚未设为 true(在 finally 中 L291) → 通过 → inputQueue.push() → finally 中 L292 inputQueue.close() → 消息被 close 的 inputQueue 丢弃 → 用户消息丢失
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: send() 中在 this.closed 检查后增加 inputQueue 的 isClosed() 检查

suggestedFix.summary: loadTimeline 按 content.trim() 过滤可能误删仅有 attachments/images 的非 user 消息
suggestedFix.evidence: loadTimeline L136: entry.role !== "user" && entry.content.trim().length === 0 → 过滤 → 图片/文件消息可能 content 为空但有 attachments → 这些消息被静默丢弃 → 用户看到不完整对话
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: 过滤条件改为检查 entry.content 之外的其他字段(attachments, images等)

suggestedFix.summary: loadTimeline phase 行插入假设 DB 条目升序排列，倒序遍历找 lastUserIdx 在降序返回时指向最早的 user message
suggestedFix.evidence: loadTimeline L155-166: 反向遍历找最后一条 user message → splice(lastUserIdx+1, 0, ...phaseItems) → DB 条目未保证升序 → 如果已按 timestamp 降序返回，lastUserIdx 指向最早的 user message → phase 行插在对话顶部附近而非最新消息后
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: DB 查询添加 ORDER BY timestamp ASC 或在插入前反转数组

suggestedFix.summary: TokenUsageModule 中当 selectedSources 为空时自动全选 allClients，用户无法维持空选择（不筛选任何客户端）
suggestedFix.evidence: TokenUsageModule L42-46: useEffect 监听 allClients 变化 + selectedSources.size === 0 → setSelectedSources(new Set(allClients)) → 用户点掉所有勾选后 allClients 不变会 re-render → 但因为 selectedSources.size===0 触发自动全选 → 无法实现"不筛选"
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: 添加一个用户主动清空的标记；或用 null 表示"初始未初始化"，区分用户清空操作

suggestedFix.summary: 身份恢复输入框在每个按键后立即显示验证错误，用户还未完成输入就看到红色错误提示
suggestedFix.evidence: IdentityGate L86-89: onChange → setRecoveryValue + 同步 setRecoveryError(validateUserIdInput(...)) → validateUserIdInput 对不足长度的输入返回"至少需要..." → 刚输入 1 个字符即显示错误 → 干扰用户体验
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: 添加 touched 状态，仅在用户离开输入框后才显示验证错误

suggestedFix.summary: LicenseGate 同时渲染 status.message、error、formError 三路消息，激活失败时用户看到多条冗余/矛盾信息
suggestedFix.evidence: LicenseGate L105-107: {status?.message} + {error} + {formError} 三行独立显示 → 用户提交失败看到 status.message("已尝试激活") + error("服务器错误") + formError("激活失败。") 三条 → 信息冗余
suggestedFix.suggestedFix: 合并为单一错误消息区，优先显示 formError → error → status.message 的降级逻辑
